novelty.justification: The claim predicts that “subliminally installed traits are stored redundantly and distributively” while remaining “removable by targeted low-rank/direction ablation,” so its novelty route is a parameter-storage relationship specific to subliminally transmitted traits rather than a new ablation method. Searches represented by “subliminal learning localization ablation,” “subliminal traits pruning quantization,” and “low-rank trait subspace removal” identify the closest work as “Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact” (2026), which already investigates LoRA-rank dependence and localizes subliminal behavior to computation at shared training/evaluation tokens, while Cloud et al., “Language models transmit behavioural traits through hidden signals in data” (2026), establishes the underlying phenomenon. Moving from those studies to random-ablation robustness, low-rank removability, compression survival, and comparison with matched overt traits is a non-trivial but natural extension using standard localization and compression tools, not a new core interpretability paradigm.
